transcript_full: Hello, fellow geeks, and welcome to Notting Out with Victor. I'm your host, Victor, a serial entrepreneur and proud nerd, excited to guide you through the tech-focused journey starting January 1st, 2024. Every fortnight, we release a new episode, each but an hour long, packed with cutting-edge topics and insightful discussions. In this podcast, we'll dive into a variety of themes, including AI, ML, DevSecOps, Linux, security, open hardware, as well as open source in general. Our exploration will be rich and diverse, just like the technology we love. The highlight of each episode will be a subject matter expert who brings unique insights and deep knowledge to the table. These experts include domain specialists such as open source maintainers and seasoned tech professionals who share their perspectives, experiences, and the latest trends in their fields. This is the perfect spot for fellow techies, whether you're deeply involved in the tech industry, a student navigating the exciting world of technology or someone who simply thrives on learning about tech innovations. So tune in and let's immerse ourselves in the fascinating universe of technology together. Don't forget to subscribe and tell all your geeky friends about us and I'll see you all on January 1st.
